description: Land Acquisition - Badalgama, Horakandawila, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that certain described lands are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. The content provides detailed descriptions of the specific land parcels (including lot numbers, extents, and boundaries) and their location. This falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land acquisition matters.
